verification.note: The 1+1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. The two-book union check and the past-paper back-test are STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE for this paper: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material on hand is first-year physics only, and the paper corpus holds only Paper-I papers, so neither check was run. Physics hand-checked: a wave is a disturbance that transports energy (and momentum) from one point to another while each particle of the medium only vibrates about its own mean position — the medium itself is not transported.

recall_prompt: Say what a wave carries from one point to another, and what happens to the particles of the medium.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Energy transport
lines: A wave is a disturbance that carries
energy from one point of the medium to
steps.margin_note: First mark. Two words carry it: disturbance and energy.
steps.why: The definition has to say what actually travels — the disturbance and its energy — because the next line will say the matter does NOT travel.
common_mistakes: Defining a wave as moving particles — the wave moves through the particles, not with them.
Leaving out the word energy — a wave that carried nothing would not be a disturbance worth naming.

recall.must_convey: That a wave is a disturbance carrying energy from one point to another.
accept: energy moves from point to point
reject: the particles stay at their mean positions

steps.memory_tip: Two words make the definition: disturbance, energy.

steps.label: Particles are not carried
lines: The particles of the medium are not
carried with the wave — each particle
only vibrates about its own mean

lines.text: A wave carries energy, not matter

steps.margin_note: Second mark. The contrast is the point: energy travels, matter does not.
steps.why: This is what separates a wave from a flow. In a river the water itself moves along; in a wave each particle stays near one place and only the disturbance passes through.
common_mistakes: Saying the medium flows along with the wave — a floating leaf on water waves bobs up and down, it does not travel with the wave.

recall.must_convey: That the particles of the medium only vibrate about their mean positions and are not transported.
accept: particles vibrate about their mean positions
the medium is not carried along

steps.memory_tip: Picture a leaf on water waves: it bobs in place while the wave passes under it.

insider_note: Examiners want the pair: energy IS carried, matter is NOT. Writing only one half reads as an incomplete definition.
